name: lg-arkanoid
description: LG Arkanoid Game with Phaser.js, Express, Socket.IO and Vite Live Reload Server

scripts.start: concurrently --names "SERVER,VITE,WALL" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run server" "npm run dev" "npm run open-wall"
scripts.test: node server/tests/gameEngine.test.js && node server/tests/join-url.test.js && node server/tests/ssh-launch.test.js && node server/tests/matchResult.test.js
